capabilities: Import Markdown files from a zip file into the vault
Place CSS files from the zip into the snippets folder
Configure an import folder for conflicting file names
Toggle overwriting of existing files on conflict
disambiguation: Not a general importer from other note apps; it installs template vaults delivered as zip files.
extras: README notes the plugin was pending Community Plugins review at time of writing; plugin management inside imported vaults is planned but not yet implemented, and name conflicts throw an error by default.
motivation: The author was frustrated with how many steps it takes to install templates into an existing vault and built this as a simpler solution.
problem: Installing a template vault into an existing Obsidian vault requires manually copying files across several folders, including a hidden snippets folder, with no one-click option like Notion's.

relations.evidence: Notion has a one-click install option for templates, which is sweet.

summary: Zip-file importer that installs template vaults into an existing vault, placing Markdown files and CSS snippets in their correct folders.
